entries.heading: MODIFICATION OF AUTHORITIES RELATING TO ESTABLISHMENT OF UNIFIED COMBATANT COMMAND FOR CYBER OPERATIONS
ancestors: TITLE XVI—STRATEGIC PROGRAMS, CYBER, AND INTELLIGENCE MATTERS
entries.text:
SEC. 1635. MODIFICATION OF AUTHORITIES RELATING TO ESTABLISHMENT 
                          OF UNIFIED COMBATANT COMMAND FOR CYBER 
                          OPERATIONS.

    Section 167b of title 10, United States Code, is amended--
            (1) by striking subsection (d); and
            (2) by redesignating subsections (e) and (f) as subsections 
        (d) and (e), respectively.
